criteria.requirement: The SHA-256 of the result bytes the evaluator retrieved equals the digest the receiver committed on-chain at submit.
criteria.title: Result matches the committed digest

criteria.requirement: The result bytes are valid UTF-8 and parse as a single JSON value (RFC 8259).
criteria.title: Result is JSON

criteria.requirement: The result bytes are identical to the RFC 8785 (JCS) serialization of the JSON value they parse to.
criteria.title: Result is canonical

criteria.requirement: The result is at most 65536 bytes.
criteria.title: Result size
